worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.summary: A shell-blade slash leaves shell splinters planted on the ground where it landed. A grounded foe that steps in is cut hard the first time and lightly while it stays; slashing the same ground again sharpens the splinters (up to three steps). The cut aims at a weak point and lands criticals more often than ordinary moves.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.use.0: A close slash that leaves shell splinters at the foe's feet as spikes
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.use.1: Cut the same ground again and again to grow the splinters into a blade field
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.use.2: Aim at a weak point for a heavier critical
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.descript: One shell-blade slash deals about %1$s power at about %2$s blocks, with a critical chance of about %3$s (higher than ordinary moves). The target's Defence and type matchup settle at impact.

On a hit the splinters stand in a ring about %1$s blocks wide for about %2$s. A grounded foe that steps in takes about %3$s power for the first cut (one sharpness step), and each further step adds %4$s; while it stays it is cut every %5$s for %6$s of that first cut. Airborne bodies pass above.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.relentle: Relentless: cooldown x0.55, splinters last longer and the ring is wider, at the cost of slash power x0.82 and each layer's cut x0.9 - for cutting the same ground over and over into a blade field.
Deep Cut (default): slash power x1.12 and each layer's cut x1.12, with a normal cooldown and a shorter, smaller ring, for one heavier cut.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.timing: Range %1$s, wind-up %2$s, recovery %3$s, costs %4$s PP, cooldown %5$s.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.growth.0: From level %1$s the slash power rises to %2$s and each layer's cut to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.growth.1: From level %1$s the slash power rises to %2$s and the per-layer gain to %3$s.
worldcombat.skill.ceaselessedge.preferen: On: cooldown x0.55, splinters last longer and the ring is wider, but slash power x0.82 and each layer's cut x0.9 - for cutting the same ground into a blade field. Off: deep cut, slash power x1.12 and each layer's cut x1.12, normal cooldown and a smaller, shorter ring.
Beyond this distance the companion closes in instead of slashing; larger values let it commit from further away.
When on, a target with neighbours gets priority, so the splinter ring left at its feet can cut several at once; when off, it ranks as an ordinary melee attack.
